name: custompage-read
description: A custom page read skill based on the Tradebee Website Builder Open API. It is used to read one exact custom page or list custom pages under a specified site language, with support for field selection and pagination.

language.description: Required. Exact site language code to read from, such as `en` or `fr`. Do not guess or translate it. First call `languages-get`, show the language list to the user, then copy one exact `language` value the user confirms.

custompage_id.description: Optional. Exact custom page filter. Omit this field to read all custom pages, or provide one exact positive custompage_id.

fields.description: Optional. Field selection list. Supported values: `custompage_id`, `custompage_url`, `language`, `title`, `content`, `seo`, `create_time`, `update_time`. When returning a list to the user, include `custompage_id` and `custompage_url` so one ID and one preview URL are available in the final answer. Do not tell the user they must preview it; provide the preview URL so the user can decide.

status.description: Request status. `true` indicates success and `false` indicates failure.
